technical.summary: ABT shows mixed technicals with bullish squeeze setup and supertrend support offset by bearish moving average structure, weak momentum, and lack of trend confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 40 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal; news sentiment unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (373.28), flat yield curve, imminent CPI event (0 days), and negative macro score (-5) create severely adverse conditions; earnings in 40 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish signal, positive squeeze setup, and MACD bullish confluence with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) create contrarian opportunity near support at 103.31.
